verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an AI app builder, for example batch-managing projects or applying one change across many items, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions bulk, batch or multi-item operations. The closest items cover the agent's general filesystem control (bolt-gh-2) and single-project security fixes (bolt-docs-46), and neither describes acting on many items at once, so this is unevidenced rather than not applicable.
